data.source_title: Challenges in Preanalytical Phase of Laboratory Medicine: Rate of Blood Sample Nonconformity in a Tertiary Care Hospital
data.locator: Methods, specimen accession and rejection criteria; page 22 in journal PDF
data.source_setting: Shalamar Hospital pathology laboratory, Lahore; inpatient phlebotomy by clinical staff and outpatient collection by laboratory personnel
data.source_period: Workflow described for study conducted January-December 2018
data.source_n: Not a distinct numerical outcome; process description within study of 113,817 samples
value: collection by clinical or laboratory staff
data.source_evidence_basis: Original journal PDF, Methods: samples were sorted at reception, problems entered in a manual log, and rejection criteria covered identity/request, container, quantity, hemolysis/clot, transport, closure, and transit delay.
data.limitations: This is one hospital's process description and does not specify universal acceptance standards, response times, recollection service levels, or electronic tracking. Not verified as RWJ policy.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Use a rejection branch that records reason, notification, recollection request and repeat transport, so a rejected specimen does not silently become a result. Obtain local critical-sample exceptions and escalation policies before operationalizing.
